# ICC profile notice

`chemical-proof-cmyk.icc` is the exact `profile_load("cmyk")` result from
libvips 8.18.3 as shipped in wasm-vips 0.0.18. Its embedded ICC copyright tag
states: “Created by Graeme W. Gill. Released into the public domain. No
Warranty, Use at your own risk.”

AXM identifies this profile as a generic chemical-proof CMYK condition. It must
not be relabelled as FOGRA, GRACoL, SWOP, or a particular press/paper condition.
Requests for another output condition remain unsupported until that exact
profile is installed and reviewed.
